issue_context.title: Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces is missing API documentation
issue_context.body:
See https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/84917 for more context.

The compiler generated XML file for Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces is shipping to customers via the nuget package and is missing public API documentation. The above linked PR disables the compiler error CS1591 until all the API is documented.

When working on this, remove the NoWarn=1591 setting from the project file.

review_comments: It's not actually a task.  But I see this matches what we have documented, so, fine for now.

I've seen other places where we say "A task that represents" when the returned value is the result of a ConfigureAwait. 

For future reference, what description would you prefer to use in plain English for these cases? Would this work?:

"An awaitable, configured value task that represents..."

Or would you use something else?
